acceptance: Two throughput tests and two maintenance runs execute in the TPC-DS 4.0.0 clause 7.4.2 order: a unit test with stubbed phases asserts the recorded order (load, power, throughput 1, maintenance 1, throughput 2, maintenance 2).
Load time is captured and used as T_LD
QphDS@Size uses the spec formula and is exported as official only when every input is valid
Every documentation page in this repository that describes QphDS (found with grep -rln QphDS docs) states the spec formula and the official-export rule, and make docs-validate passes.

If the owner records option B in tpcds-maintenance-data-source-decision-20261103, this item must be dropped or re-scoped as part of closing that decision. description: Scope moved here from tpcds-qphds-nonspec-formula by owner decision on 2026-10-04: suppress the non-spec QphDS first, and implement the spec later. QphDS@Size = SF x Q / (T_PT x T_TT x T_DM x T_LD)^(1/4), with Q = 99 x S, T_TT = TT1 + TT2, T_DM = DM1 + DM2, and T_LD = 0.01 x S x T_load. Needs a second throughput test (streams S+1..2S), data maintenance between the throughput tests, and captured load time.
